sourceSentences: [0] Ari is weak level one. So look for cheese. Her only ability to cancel your Q will be a charm.
[0] So once you dodge or she misses it, WQ in to burst her down. Even at level six, she don't stand a chance into ASO.
[0] Once you dodge her charms, always look for WQ combo to burn her R.
[0] That is by far one of the easiest match up for ASO as you outskll and outrange her
[1] Very weak early game champion. He lacks damage and mobility early, so any form of damage is life threatening to him. When he E -> Q's the wave it's prime time to go in for a Charm.
[1] If he does W and try to Q you to death you can use the R dashes to force his slow turn rate to lag behind you and look in for an easy charm as he'll be moving in a straight line.
[1] You win lane and out push him. When he Qs use your Abilities. Try to stop him from scaling and stack drags.
[1] Early play aggro try to snowball as much as u can and he shouldnt be a problem. still scales great into lategame so be aware
[1] This big boy loves to roam and he roams faster than you, so clean the waves to get a clear shot with your e, use your ultimate to dodge his, and engage him.
[1] Ahri is a great counter to Aurelion. Just charm him when he starts flying towards you and kill him
[2] You can shove her early, but avoid the charm at all costs. If she misses charm, you can trade with her - be careful of the jungler.
[2] Its probably not worth using your R after her first dash, as she will just use the other two to get back.
[2] Basically dodge her skillshots and don't W in weird ways or you get punished hard by her charm.
